review: Independent ORIGINAL-criterion iteration6 clean108 qualification-source review
scope: Integrated source review plus bounded recheck of the two identified source blockers and no-agent validation guard. Source is ready to commit and qualify in actual Actions; this does not approve MAIN or claim research results.
original_criterion: Fresh matched evidence for feasibility of operation models and prospective Bering-to-Sheaft forecasts with absent/partial SDK tracing, judged against independent external outcomes and equal-information strongest simple baselines. Scientific success is not admission, graph availability or internal model accuracy alone.
design: 108 fresh cells: 3 applications x 3 SDK modes x 4 collector states (none/OBI/Coroot/DeepFlow) x 3 new repetitions; 27 randomized paired blocks; fresh guest resets, common pinned blueprint, separate training and validation epochs; all four real model/forecast bundles frozen before any validation target. Prior81 remains immutable historical evidence.

bounded_fix_findings.evidence: Both reuse_single_source_equivalence and reuse_unchanged_union resolve to the frozen combined graph only after equality with the frozen combined forecast. Actual new context unions resolve to their own operations graph. Available forecasts retain simulator=Sheaft and executed graph SHA checks.

Full git ls-files census covers src, systems and scripts plus series-v6/checks workflows, PROTOCOL_V6 and pyproject, replacing the partial implementation list. MAIN compares the entire resulting map. The qualification approval document alone is outside the source census to avoid self-reference.

No-agent indexed eBPF span count is checked by common acquisition validation, which runs after fresh validation ingestion as well as training ingestion. Any ebpf-* source in none invalidates technical acquisition.

causal_and_prospective_boundary: Observer effects require contemporaneous randomized matched runtime arms. No-agent is an actual runtime state, not a projection. SDK tracing disabled does not mean libraries removed. OBI propagation remains an explicit active treatment. New-boot identity supports only frozen blueprint aliases and classification; validation does not refit or repair models from target labels.
baselines: Same semantic contracts, native information and supplied alias knowledge go to direct conditional arithmetic, native-only and observed SERVER-edge/context union baselines. Equality, UNKNOWN, negative and adverse outcomes remain admissible final findings; no assumed novel predictor or superiority.
costs: Comparable preparation, clean controls, capture, failed work, model execution, transfer/hash/retention, overlap, paging, CI/review and early-stop costs must all remain counted; human and unmeasured costs remain unknown. No cost-dominance conclusion is authorized by source review.
qualification_boundary: Actual full-size runtime/disk/RAM/six-hour and publication/restore qualification remains required by the existing design and MAIN gate. Source CI and actual qualification must use committed source: git ls-files intentionally sees tracked paths; new v6 files are still untracked at this local review. No additional execution or scientific result is certified here.
validation_evidence: Read-only source inspection only; no tests, capture, model fitting, replay, network or Actions performed by this reviewer. Root separately reports 32 focused tests, actionlint, bash syntax, compileall and diff checks passing; full pytest still pending at review.
